title: declarative-rbac-policy-executor-and-geo-kms-mapper
author: Priya Nair
description: Context: Customers have asked for a way to author RBAC v2 policy bundles declaratively and bind those to jurisdiction-aware KMS selection rules so that operator credentials and service requests automatically resolve to region-appropriate keys. This PR introduces a small, focused runtime component (policy-executor) that evaluates declarative policy templates at admission time and a lightweight kms-mapper library that annotates requests with KMS selection hints used by the routing layer. Motivation: reduce hand-edited role bindings, make operator scope deterministic, and improve audit signals so that KMS choices and RBAC decisions are traceable and reproducible. Changes: 1) Add policy-executor service that consumes policy-bundle.yaml and exposes an /evaluate endpoint used by operator-claim-webhook; 2) Implement kms-mapper library (go) to convert policy attributes (jurisdiction, zone, tenant-residency) into kms selection hints and canonical audit tags; 3) Extend audit enrichment pipeline to include kms_hint and policy_fingerprint fields; 4) Add feature-flag gate (rbac.declarative_executor) and staged rollout config for installer; 5) Migrate a small set of operator policies (operator-lease, operator-approval) to the new bundle format as examples; 6) Add end-to-end integration tests and CI job. Rollout plan: feature gated by default; after internal canary (10% of operator traffic) enable shadow evaluation in production to compare executor decisions against the legacy engine for 48h; if diffs < 0.1% and no behavioral regressions, flip executor to active for the canary cohort and gradually expand. Linear/Jira: ENG-8421 (policy executor), ENG-8450 (kms mapping), SUP-1294 (support ticket). Checklist: - [x] Unit tests for executor decision logic - [x] kms-mapper conversion table and docs - [x] Audit enrichment schema bump (+migration script) - [x] Installer flag and private-installer compatibility shim - [x] Integration tests (local + staging) - [x] Backwards-compatibility checks with legacy RBAC engine - [x] Observability: metrics, histograms for decision latency, audit tag propagation testpoints Testing notes: executor added a 2ms median latency in local bench; integration test includes chaotic KMS fallback scenario; CI now runs new e2e:rbac-kms. Security review: scoped to operator-only paths; all policy templates are validated against schema and checked for deny-by-default semantics; kms-mapper returns only hints (does not perform crypto ops). Migration: existing policy YAMLs remain supported; a conversion script (tools/policyctl convert) is included to assist teams. Backout: feature flag and automated safety net that re-writes request annotations to legacy values if audit discrepancy rate exceeds threshold. Related: improves audit fidelity required by several customers in EU and APAC, and reduces manual RBAC drift.

review_comments: Marcus Chen: Please clarify failure modes—what happens when policy-executor is unavailable?

Priya Nair: When the executor is down the webhook falls back to the legacy engine; the request remains authorized by the last-known policy fingerprint if feature is active for canary, and we surface discrepancy metrics to infra-alerting.
Elena Soto: The audit schema change needs migration testing against live clickhouse shards; can we add a dry-run migration?
Priya Nair: Added 202511_migrate_audit_schema.sql which supports dry-run mode and backwards-compat tags; tested on staging snapshot and included results in the PR artifacts.
Rajiv Kapoor: kms-mapper contains a hardcoded geozone table; prefer config-driven mapping with unit tests for overrides.
Priya Nair: Converted the table to a config file (policy/kms_zones.yaml) and added override precedence rules; added unit tests demonstrating override behavior.
Marcus Chen: Approving pending one nit about log verbosity in handler_evaluate.go (too chatty at info level).
Priya Nair: Reduced log level and added structured error codes for easier alerting.
ci_summary: All checks passed after two reruns: unit tests, linters, go vet, e2e:rbac-kms job. Flaky external KMS test was mocked for CI to keep run deterministic.
release_notes: Add declarative RBAC policy executor and jurisdiction-aware KMS mapping. Feature gated behind rbac.declarative_executor; audit enriched with kms_hint and policy_fingerprint. No immediate behavioral change until feature is enabled. Includes migration helper for audit schema.
notes_for_ops: Enable feature via installer/values/rbac-declarative.yaml; recommended canary rollout: 10% traffic -> shadow mode 48h -> active canary -> gradual expansion. Monitor metrics rbac.executor.decision_diff_rate and audit.kms_hint_mismatch_rate; migration script must be run in dry-run mode first.
security_considerations: Policy templates validated against strict schema; executor runs with minimal privileges and only reads policy bundles; kms-mapper produces non-authoritative hints and never performs key operations. Added unit tests for deny-by-default semantics and fuzz tests for policy parsing.
